children: Hain Celestial entered into a Share Purchase Agreement with affiliates of Aurelius to sell its International business in the U.K., Ireland and Europe, including Ella's Kitchen, Joya, Natumi, Hartley's, Cully & Sully, Yorkshire Provender and New Covent Garden. The deal values the business at £233.0 million plus a locked-box ticker of about £5.5 million, for an estimated £238.5 million (about $323.2 million). Net cash proceeds are expected between £225.1 million and £228.8 million (about $305.0–$310.0 million), which the company plans to use to reduce debt. Closing is subject to regulatory approvals and an extension of Hain's credit agreement maturity by at least nine months by Oct 12, 2026.
: Share Purchase Agreement for sale of International business
: Divest non-core assets and reduce indebtedness
